reserveReview.rationale: The authored slice is a 100% unclassified whole-token reserve allocation because current whole-book coverage and reserve weights are not established. Apex's September ISAE 3000 reasonable-assurance examination separately identifies CHF 1,955,962.35 solely in cash in VNX Global Ltd.'s designated CHF reserve account ending 5557 at Bermuda Commercial Bank, separately maintained from operating accounts, against CHF 1,955,934.72 of covered outstanding VCHF at September 30, 2026 23:59:59 UTC; the same CHF 27.63 excess is reported at the 9 September 2026 random testing time. The September report covers the same six deployments and again excludes Tezos, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Polygon, XRPL and Fraxtal, so it still does not establish whole-token coverage. That cash-only, segregated subset covers Stellar, Ethereum, Solana, ICP, Celo and Base; it is not complete reserve evidence for all tracked VCHF. The August report corroborates the same cash-only structure, with CHF 2,035,962.35 against CHF 2,035,934.72 at August 31. The diagnostic coverage denominator records Ethereum net of the 9,900 frozen tokens excluded by Apex; their legal extinguishment or current economically owed status is not established. Tezos, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Polygon, XRPL and Fraxtal are absent from the attested liability table. Legacy supply observations are context about excluded liabilities only: pinned totalSupply() reads using npm run research:dwellir-rpc give Avalanche 546,986.70877, Arbitrum 166.8765, Polygon 1,577.05199 and Fraxtal 371.37006 VCHF. Tezos's six active historical ledger balances at level 14748075 sum to 3.04882 VCHF (18 decimals); deleted/inactive keys are excluded. XRPL gateway_balances and complete account_lines at validated ledger 106677545 show zero VCHF obligations/balances, with no pagination marker. These legacy balances total 549,105.05614 VCHF, but token quantities do not establish reserve asset values or bank-asset percentages. No currentBookPartition is authored: there is no matched captured B4 book census or current exclusion determination. The report's current whole-token liability share remains unknown, so its cash composition is retained as separate evidence rather than an authored bank-deposit slice. No reportScopeId is attached to the whole-book residual. The CHF 27.63 attested excess is not assigned to legacy claims. The residual carries no asset class, obligor or tracked dependency; its required medium display-risk field supplies no affirmative cash or bank-deposit allocation. No maximum withdrawal horizon is evidenced. Avalanche's unidentified address 0x21097a336E7A63ba30A93429Efe5C2ae42BA2827 held 536,393.203982589285442413 VCHF at the same pin; no treasury exclusion or beneficial owner is inferred. The legacy census remains the August 31 pin; no newer whole-book census is authored for the September period, so no whole-token cash percentage is inferred. RPC provenance, observed October 17, 2026: Avalanche block 94159927, hash 0x3772b9d348435e811e4d08049c171cb832dd76e3cfeabd3f9fb5581d53479a90, time 23:59:55 UTC, observed 09:18:56.697 UTC; Arbitrum block 500455223, hash 0x1f20144622f24a328045752256c3bd53b1cc4b655e1b94711a307f53e2cbbf73, time 23:59:59 UTC, observed 09:20:45.496 UTC; Polygon block 93010514, hash 0x757a01f01f2cc62ad8382cf882d83dd47ea9c196332207a7dd2c646125d6daaf, time 23:59:58 UTC, observed 09:20:45.486 UTC; Fraxtal block 40705044, hash 0x795a19015a9c4c68e3727f1fe4c289df793bb4507ccd3c44a9d975f5ad08db6a, time 23:59:59 UTC, observed 09:18:46.611 UTC. Tezos level 14748075, hash BLj2Qqwa8SpcGBZWnwm2MqgQ3ukrGmaaPhRhN1H1Y96fLrCDhac, time 23:59:55 UTC. XRPL ledger 106677545, hash 546C7E890D06D3B1105F85CA5E85FAF5E364E2D96D8E615E362F95BDA91B61CD, time 23:59:51 UTC, observed 09:21:13 UTC; all block times are August 31, 2026. Tezos historical records and XRPL account_lines were retrieved October 17, 2026. The closest preceding blocks/ledger are used; their at-most-eight-second offset from the report checkpoint is disclosed, not asserted to be a simultaneous financial attestation.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The whole-token reserve allocation remains unclassified. Apex identifies CHF 1,955,962.35 cash at Bermuda Commercial Bank against CHF 1,955,934.72 of covered VCHF on six deployments, with accounts separately maintained from operations. Backing and custody continuity for excluded legacy deployments remain unreconciled, and no matched current book partition establishes the attested subset's whole-token share. The pinned legacy census documents excluded liabilities only, not reserve weights; no partial cash percentage or whole-token cash credit is inferred.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Apex inspected bank statements and independent bank confirmations for designated CHF account ending 5557, held in VNX Global Ltd.'s name at Bermuda Commercial Bank. It assessed separate maintenance from operating accounts and identified cash-only reserves for the six covered deployments at the August testing times. This establishes segregation within that attested scope; whole-token segregation remains unknown because custody and reserve continuity for excluded legacy liabilities are unreconciled. Provider shares and a whole-token unknown-exposure percentage are omitted: no current book partition or reserve asset allocation across covered and legacy claims is established. Bankruptcy remoteness, holder insolvency priority, rehypothecation, and bank-failure/succession arrangements remain unestablished by this examination. The report expressly retains bank credit, operational and availability risks and gives no assurance on subsequent reserve levels.
